request: Explain Rental Studio and make everyday rental management as approachable as sale orders, including mobile controls.
implemented: Admin and seller order-type tabs preserve explicit store scope and mount only the selected workflow.
Rental orders default to all bookings, including future reservations, with native search, view and status filters.
Focused booking summary shows customer, items, use days, pickup/return, payment, refundable security and lifecycle.
Stage- and permission-aware actions reuse existing protected rental endpoints and operation IDs/revisions.
Actual payment amount/reference, handover piece checklist, return selection and cancellation note are checked before submitting.
Single next actions have one save button; scanners, detailed contact, photo proof, courier, invoice and workshop tools are progressively disclosed.
Mobile Rentals tab opens rental orders; setup sidebar entry opens guided setup; existing physical-stock tools remain available.
Merchant instructions explain the daily Orders flow and the purpose of rental setup and stock.
limits: Not deployed; frontend redeploy is required for these admin UI changes.
No live payment, SMS, managed licence, database or real shop inventory acceptance performed.
Physical piece availability, transactions, payment verification, full payment before handover and existing refund safeguards remain authoritative.
